business_problem: Scalestack needed to unify first-party, third-party, and zero-party go-to-market data so sales teams could stop manually researching prospects and act on AI-generated recommendations faster.
solution_summary: Scalestack built its AI-powered go-to-market data orchestration platform on MongoDB Atlas running on Amazon Web Services so sales teams could work from one live operational data layer instead of juggling disconnected inputs. The platform ingests first-party CRM records, third-party sources such as LinkedIn, Crunchbase, and ZoomInfo, and zero-party lead information from marketing forms. MongoDB Atlas stores those varied datasets in a document model that can absorb new formats quickly, which lets Scalestack automate workflow assembly and prioritize the actions sellers should take next. Atlas also provides the real-time processing and query performance the company needs to keep customer data current as GTM plays evolve. By consolidating structured and unstructured GTM data on one developer-friendly platform, Scalestack can keep its lean team focused on product innovation while its customers get AI assistance that turns fragmented sales intelligence into execution-ready plays.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores and unifies GTM data from multiple sources so Scalestack can automate sales workflows and surface prioritized actions.

data_flow: CRM records, external GTM datasets, and lead-form submissions are ingested into MongoDB Atlas, organized into automated workflows, and surfaced back through Scalestack's AI platform so sellers can identify and act on the most relevant opportunities quickly.
business_outcome: Scalestack streamlined data management, improved query performance, and helped customers increase rep productivity by 40% while achieving an average 53x ROI on the platform.
